🚀 Higgsfield’s new marketing studio looks wild
You can upload a product image or paste a product link, use an avatar from your photo or build one inside the tool, and generate a full ad end to end in styles like UGC, unboxing, reviews and more
What’s interesting is how much this shifts the workflow. Instead of creating separate parts of an ad one by one, the tool is aiming to generate the whole thing in a more complete format
That could be really useful for marketers, creators, and small brands that want to move faster without building everything from scratch every time. Definitely one to keep an eye on
